title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt metrics into CI gating & add regression hooks
author: Claire Huang
description: Motivation: Flaky model regressions are often masked by aggregate metrics. This PR wires per-prompt metrics and threshold-based gating into the eval-harness CI integration to detect prompt-set regressions earlier and provide actionable traces for rollbacks. Changes include a new per-prompt metrics collector, CI hook that fails builds when an evaluated prompt drops below configured thresholds, a lightweight dashboard payload included in job artifacts, and docs/examples for adding new prompt sets. Checklist: [x] implement per-prompt metrics collection, [x] add CI hook and gating logic, [x] add artifact payload + summary, [x] add unit & integration tests, [x] update docs and examples, [x] update changelog. Impact: This tightens the CI safety net for model rollouts and surfaced the failing prompt examples to expedite triage.
